meta.description: Spectral Interpretation Knowledge Base – mapping detected atomic/molecular species to material, biologic, and geological classes. Generated by spectral_engine.py.

chlorophyll_a+b.notes: Blue Soret; paired with 670nm confirms chlorophyll

chlorophyll_green_peak.notes: Green reflectance peak between red+blue absorptions; not an absorption

phycocyanin.notes: Dominant in cyanobacteria, absent in higher plants

chlorophyll_a.notes: Red Qy; depth correlates with LAI and chlorophyll content

red_edge_inflection.notes: Inflection of red-edge; position shifts with chlorophyll stress

red_edge_plateau.notes: Shoulder marking transition to NIR plateau

oxyhemoglobin_soret.notes: Strong Soret band; differentiates blood from other pigments

deoxyhemoglobin.notes: Single broad band vs HbO2 doublet; indicates deoxygenation

Fe3+_goethite.notes: Goethite spin-forbidden; intensity low but diagnostic

Fe2+_olivine_pyroxene.notes: Band I; position depends on Mg/Fe ratio in olivine/pyroxene

Fe2+_Band_I_orthopyroxene.notes: OPx Band I; shifts with Ca content

Fe2+_Band_II_pyroxene.notes: Band II; Band I/Band II ratio diagnoses pyroxene type

Cu2+.notes: Turquoise, malachite, azurite broad Cu absorption

O2_A_band_atmospheric.notes: Telluric O2 A-band; seen in solar-reflected spectra

H2O_atmospheric.notes: Water vapor column; band depth ~ pwv

OH_water.notes: Strong; liquid water ~1450, structural OH shifts 1380–1420

liquid_water.notes: H2O bend+stretch combination; liquid water diagnostic

ice_H2O.notes: Ice band shifts vs liquid water

structural_OH.notes: Bound OH overtone; kaolinite, serpentine, chlorite doublet ~1390+1410

Al-OH.notes: MOST DIAGNOSTIC clay feature; kaolinite 2200, smectite 2205, illite 2195–2210

Mg-OH_Fe-OH.notes: Mg-OH or Fe-OH; serpentine, chlorite, nontronite

gypsum_SO4.notes: Gypsum SO4 band; rare outside evaporites

jarosite.notes: Jarosite Fe-OH; paired with Fe3+ VIS absorptions

cellulose_CH.notes: Cellulose CH combination; dry biomass indicator

protein_NH.notes: Protein N-H; correlates with leaf N content

protein_amide.notes: Amide II band combination; protein secondary structure

CH_lipid_vs_OH.notes: Overlap region; deconvolve FWHM to separate CH from OH

CH2_lipid.notes: Fatty acid CH2; first overtone of C-H stretch ~3450 cm-1

CH2_CH3_hydrocarbon.notes: Strong CH2/CH3 combination; crude oil, coal, plastics

CH_aliphatic.notes: Aliphatic CH; overlaps carbonate – use FWHM to distinguish

soil_organic_matter.notes: SOM broad feature; correlates with organic carbon %

polypropylene_CH.notes: PP methyl group; differs from PE

nylon_NH.notes: Nylon amide NH; similar to protein but context differs

polymer_CH.notes: CH combination; present in many polymers

Si-OH.notes: Si-OH; opal, amorphous silica, altered feldspar

Fe2+_feldspar.notes: Fe2+ in anorthite site; darkens plagioclase

REE_apatite.notes: Nd in apatite; narrows above ambient background

Mg-OH_Fe-OH_chlorite.notes: Chlorite; position shifts with Fe/Mg ratio

coal_aromatic.notes: Aromatic ring absorption; rank correlates with depth

coal_CH2.notes: Aliphatic CH2 overtone; decreases with rank

composite_signatures.interpretation: Chl without strong red-edge: stressed or senescing plant

composite_signatures.name: dry_plant_litter
composite_signatures.interpretation: Cellulose+lignin without liquid water: senescent/dry biomass

composite_signatures.name: pyroxene_orthopyroxene
composite_signatures.interpretation: Dual-band pyroxene; OPx Band I + Band II

composite_signatures.name: hematite_iron_oxide
composite_signatures.interpretation: Hematite: VIS crystal-field + broad CT edge

composite_signatures.name: cyanobacteria_algae
composite_signatures.interpretation: Phycocyanin + Chl: cyanobacteria or mixed algae

category_glossary.mineral: Crystalline inorganic phase (oxide, silicate, carbonate, sulphate, phosphate, etc.)
category_glossary.biologic: Living or recently living organism tissue (vegetation, algae, blood, protein, etc.)
category_glossary.organic: Non-living organic compound (petroleum, coal, polymer, humus)
category_glossary.geological: Geological material or process (altered rock, evaporite, cryosphere)
category_glossary.hazard: Material with known health or environmental hazard

spectral_rules_of_thumb: FWHM < 10 nm: electronic transition (f→f REE, O2, sharp molecular)
FWHM 10–50 nm: crystal-field (Fe2+, Fe3+, Cu2+, Cr3+, Mn2+) or chlorophyll
FWHM 50–150 nm: vibrational overtone or combination band (OH, CH, NH, CO3)
FWHM > 150 nm: broad crystal-field or mixed-phase signal
1450 + 1940 → liquid H2O present (fresh water, moist tissue, hydrated mineral)
Band I ~900 + Band II ~2000 → pyroxene (ratio diagnoses type)
Narrow triplet 580+745+800 nm → REE Nd3+ (carbonatite, phosphate, REE deposit)
Broad 530 + 700 → Fe3+ oxide (hematite vs goethite by exact position)
